title: Sector Stream Record
description: Per-(warp, memory access) record produced by the C-AC-F sector stream generator under tools/sector_stream/. Each record is one of two top-level shapes: an admitted sector-stream summary (result_kind=sector_stream) or a typed exclusion (result_kind=typed_exclusion). The schema covers both branches via the oneOf below so downstream consumers can validate both paths against the same artifact. Producer-side enforcement of the `MemoryOpClass` vocabulary is handled before this generator runs (UNSPECIFIED is routed to nvbit_unsupported_memory_path.schema.json upstream); a value reaching this generator that is not in {GLOBAL, LOCAL, SHARED, TEXTURE, SURFACE, ATOMIC, TMA, ASYNC_COPY, CLUSTER_DSMEM} is rejected with sector_stream_class_unsupported so the validator can still admit the record.

result_kind.description: Discriminator. Pinned to `sector_stream` for the admitted branch.

touched_32B_sectors.description: Number of distinct 32-byte sector identifiers the warp's active+predicated lanes touched. Vector loads (data_width > 32) that span a 32B boundary contribute the additional sector(s).

touched_128B_lines.description: Number of distinct 128-byte line identifiers the warp's active+predicated lanes touched. Always less than or equal to touched_32B_sectors (a 128B line contains four 32B sectors).

sectors_per_request.description: Per-warp memory-request metric: number of distinct 32B sectors touched by this single warp instruction. One warp instruction issues one memory request to the L1 path; the request touches between 1 sector (broadcast/uniform: every active lane lands in the same 32B sector) and 32 sectors (scattered worst case). The original plan's sector-stream regression invariant pins uniform/broadcast warps at sectors_per_request == 1.0; this is identical to touched_32B_sectors and is reported separately so downstream consumers can read the coalescer-efficiency signal without reaching into the touched-sector set.

classification.description: Categorical access pattern. `uniform`: all active lanes hit the same 32B sector (good case). `broadcast`: all active lanes share the same starting address (degenerate uniform). `strided`: active lanes' sorted starting addresses form a constant nonzero stride. `overlap`: distinct lanes' [addr, addr+data_width) ranges intersect. `scattered`: nothing simpler matches (worst case).

memory_op_class.description: Admitted memory class. Only GLOBAL and LOCAL produce admitted sector-stream records in this loop; the other classes route through the typed_exclusion branch.

active_lane_count.description: Number of lanes contributing to the touched-sector / touched-line counts (i.e., bits set in active_mask & predicate_mask). Always >= 1 in the admitted branch (zero participation routes to the no_lanes_active typed exclusion).

result_kind.description: Discriminator. Pinned to `typed_exclusion` for the rejection branch.

typed_reason.description: Member of the sector-stream taxonomy family declared at C-AC-C. `no_lanes_active`: (active_mask & predicate_mask) == 0. `lane_address_length_invalid`: lane_addresses sequence length != 32 (NVIDIA SIMT warp width). `data_width_invalid`: data_width not in {1, 2, 4, 8, 16}. `sector_stream_class_unsupported`: memory_op_class is one of {SHARED, TEXTURE, SURFACE, ATOMIC, TMA, ASYNC_COPY, CLUSTER_DSMEM} or any other unrecognized value.

memory_op_class.description: Memory operation class observed on the rejected record. Free-form string (not enum-restricted) so producer-side caller bugs (e.g. a stray sentinel value) are visible at the schema level rather than masked by enum rejection.

observed_length.description: Length of lane_addresses observed when typed_reason is lane_address_length_invalid; absent for other typed reasons.

expected_length.description: Pinned to 32 (the NVIDIA SIMT warp width) when typed_reason is lane_address_length_invalid; absent for other typed reasons.

observed_data_width.description: Value of data_width observed when typed_reason is data_width_invalid; absent for other typed reasons. Free-form integer so caller bugs (e.g., a stray negative) are visible.

allowed_data_widths.description: Sorted list of allowed data widths {1, 2, 4, 8, 16} when typed_reason is data_width_invalid; absent for other typed reasons.

active_mask.description: Active mask observed when typed_reason is no_lanes_active; absent for other typed reasons.

predicate_mask.description: Predicate mask observed when typed_reason is no_lanes_active; absent for other typed reasons.
